## Guides
- [Guides and ideas](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/): How to choose decking, size a deck, pick a fence style and plan a patio, written for people who haven't built one before.
- [Backyard Ideas on a Slope](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/backyard-ideas-small-and-sloped-yards/): What actually fits in a small or sloping Georgia backyard, the order to build it in, and which ideas are worth the money once the ground isn't flat.
- [Types of Fences and Decking](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/choosing-materials-decking-fencing-patios/): Side by side comparisons of fence types, decking materials, and porch against patio against deck, with what each choice costs you five years later.
- [How to Stain a Deck in Georgia](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/clean-stain-and-seal-a-deck/): Pollen, humidity and afternoon storms decide when you can stain a deck here and how long it lasts. The cleaning, the product choice and the weather window.
- [Deck Design Ideas](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/deck-design-ideas/): Railings, skirting, lighting, multi level layouts and what to do with the space underneath, with what each idea does to the framing that has to carry it.
- [Deck Size and Board Calculator](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/deck-size-and-board-calculator/): A working calculator for deck square footage, board count and joist count, plus the framing spacings that decide how a deck feels underfoot.
- [Fire Pit Ideas and Designs](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/fire-pit-ideas-and-costs/): Built-in and freestanding fire pit designs, sizing for the number of chairs you own, seating layouts, gas against wood, and what drives the build.
- [How to Read a Fence Quote](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/how-to-read-a-fence-quote/): How fence pricing works, what a per-foot number hides, how chain link, wood, vinyl and aluminum rank, and what a fence quote should itemize.
- [Patio and Walkway Ideas](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/patio-and-walkway-design-ideas/): Paver patterns, patio shapes, walkway routes and cover options, and what each layout choice does to where rainwater ends up in your yard.
- [Pergola Ideas and Designs](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/pergola-ideas-and-how-to-choose-one/): What a pergola does about sun, what it doesn't do about rain, how it differs from a gazebo or a pavilion, and the designs that suit a Georgia backyard.
- [Privacy Fence Ideas and Styles](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/privacy-fence-ideas-and-styles/): Board on board, shadowbox, horizontal and picket, with what each style does for privacy and airflow and what it asks of the posts holding it up.
- [Retaining Walls Compared](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/retaining-walls-block-timber-boulder/): When a yard actually needs a wall, which material suits which slope, what has to sit behind the block, and what moves the number on a quote.
- [Screened Porch Ideas](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/screened-porch-front-porch-sunroom-ideas/): Layouts, ceilings, screen systems and floors for screened porches, front porches and sunrooms, with the trade-off each choice makes in light and airflow.
- [Screened Porch, Sunroom or 3-Season Room](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/screened-porch-sunroom-or-three-season-room/): The three routes to a screened room, screening an existing porch, building new, or going to glass, and what each step adds to the number.
- [What Sits Under a Patio Quote](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/what-sits-under-a-patio-quote/): Why two quotes for the same patio differ, what sits under the surface, how paver, concrete, stamped and flagstone rank, and what a quote should itemize.
- [Wood Fence Maintenance and Repair](https://ramirezdecks.com/guides/wood-fence-maintenance-and-repair/): When to stain a new fence, why posts rot at the ground line, how deep we set a post, how much concrete each takes, and when repair beats replacement.
